scientific_integrity: Copula positivity proved for every real parameter value with boundary equality. Rank-correlation identities derived from definitions; the earlier printed Kendall expression differs from this direct calculation and is not used. No external independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the specified two-term diagonal polynomial density only; not higher Legendre modes, cross terms or arbitrary copulas. Finite numerical tests complement a complete analytic proof. Literature priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Exact admissibility and sharp rank-correlation ranges for the two-mode Legendre copula
